arguments_redacted.content: The CSV parser has a bug in the `first_data_row` function. It assumes that the first line of the CSV file contains data, but it does not handle the case where the file might be empty or the first line might be a header. This could lead to an `IndexError` when trying to split an empty string or a header line.
